description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountant's Service - 7th Amendment
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service, which falls under public service administration. It deals with educational qualifications and service conditions for public sector accountants, published by the Public Service Commission. This fits the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it involves public service recruitment criteria and service conditions rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
